subject: Ops cadence & coverage: crosswalk for customer workshop week
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jeff Bennett <jeff.bennett@palladiumsystems.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Cc: events@westin.com
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Ops cadence & coverage: crosswalk for customer workshop week

Hi all —

We need to lock down on-call and room coverage for the Palladium Systems workshop week (Nov 29–Dec 3). Key asks:
- Confirm core presenter rotation windows across APAC/EU/US overlap slots.
- Finalize on-site host (redwood lead) per day + remote fallback owner.
- Agree run-of-show changes and where we tolerate up to 10m drift for transitions.

Draft plan attached: workshop-run-of-show-v3.pdf (high level schedule + AV needs). Venue has temporarily blocked meeting rooms; Westin is in cc for any immediate venue questions.

My suggested split:
- Day 1 (Nov 29): full-day customer immersion — Marissa lead in-person, Grace remote support for EU/ASIA bridge.
- Day 2: technical deep-dive — Karthik lead, Tessa shadow for logistics/resiliency.
- Day 3: executive Q/A and rollout planning — Marissa + Karthik co-present.

Please reply with: 1) any conflicts, 2) who can cover the 7:30–10:00 PST overlap window on Nov 30 (this is the tough slot for APAC->US handoffs), and 3) whether we should swap any days based on travel/visa constraints.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20m sync if helpful.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: workshop-run-of-show-v3.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Jeff Bennett <jeff.bennett@palladiumsystems.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Ops cadence & coverage: crosswalk for customer workshop week

Karthik — thanks for the clear ask. A few quick notes:

1) I can cover Day 1 in-person as suggested. No travel conflicts for me.
2) For the 7:30–10:00 PST overlap on Nov 30: Grace can take primary support for the first hour, then I can step in for the second hour to land the technical segment.
3) Two small run-of-show edits: add a 15m buffer after the lunch Q/A, and move the executive 1:1s earlier (to avoid the late-afternoon east-coast call pileup).

Also looping Westin (events@westin.com) to confirm A/V staging window and whether we can extend rehearsal access on Nov 28 to 5pm — that helps the day-1 dry run.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Engagement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Karthik / team —

Thanks for pulling this together. A couple of notes from our side:
- Nov 29 arrival: our execs land midday; we appreciate Marissa leading Day 1.
- Nov 30 timing: we prefer heavy technical sessions in the earlier overlap window (7:30–9:30 PST) so our APAC engineers can present without staying extremely late.
- Can you confirm whether the rehearsal on Nov 28 can start at 3pm? Our lead engineer needs an earlier slot.

Also saw the run-of-show — one ask: can you add a short ‘post-mortem/feedback’ slot on Day 3 (30m) so we capture actions while everyone’s still on-site?

Thanks everyone — quick summary and final asks below.

Summary (final):
- Nov 28 rehearsal: confirmed at 15:00–17:00 by Westin (events@westin.com confirmed access). Attachment: venue-blocking-confirmation.pdf.
- Day 1 (Nov 29): Marissa on-site lead; Grace shadow remote and own 7:30–8:30 PST bridge.
- Day 2 (Nov 30): Technical deep-dive 07:30–12:00 PST — Grace first hour, Marissa second hour, Karthik leads afternoon demo.
- Day 3 (Dec 1): Exec Q/A + post-mortem (30m) at 15:00 local. Karthik + Marissa co-present.

Open items (action owners):
- Marissa: update run-of-show with 15m lunch buffer + move exec 1:1s earlier (deadline: Tue 11/24 EOD).
- Grace: confirm the EU attendee dial-in details and verify tokenization for remote demo (deadline: Mon 11/23).
- Tessa: confirm backup laptops (AV) and courier ETA for hardware arriving Nov 28 (deadline: Wed 11/25).
- Jeff / Palladium: confirm executive attendee list and arrival times (Jeff to send by Mon 11/23).

I’ve attached the final run-of-show and venue confirmation. If there are no objections by Tue EOD, I’ll lock calendar invites and update the Redwood on-call rota.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Ops, Redwood Inference
